blocks.text: The Cebu Doctors University Hospital (CDUH) celebrated its 54th anniversary with a gala night on September 2, 2026, at the Pacific Grand Ballroom of Waterfront Hotel & Casino in Lahug, Cebu City. The celebration brought together members of the CebuDoc family, medical professionals, hospital staff, partners, and guests for an evening of recognition, fellowship, and celebration. Adding to the occasion was the birthday of CebuDoc Group President and Chairman of the board Dr. Potenciano “Yong” S.D.
